description: 24.28 [PRECISION] lets the attacker promote a CHARACTER group 'visible to an attacking model'; 13.09 HIDDEN limits visibility, and its INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM test is the model's OWN keyword (19.03: models in an Attached unit do not gain other models' keywords; 02.05.01 'A model only has its own keywords'). Regression: the PRECISION gate judged an attached leader with the folded allocation unit, i.e. the BODYGUARD's keywords — an INFANTRY leader of a VEHICLE bodyguard (11e Big Mek / Mek -> Mek Gunz) was never hidden and could be picked while hidden beyond 15". Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive, Shooting phase: Warboss Alpha re-attached to the Mek Gunz stands in a light area ~20" from Custodian Guard Alpha; the defender's allocation overlay for a PRECISION batch shows NO PrecisionPicker; with the Guard at ~11" (inside the detection range) the picker is offered.

steps.comment: a shooting phase_start window (not under test), if any

Setup privileges: Warboss Alpha (INFANTRY CHARACTER) is re-attached to the Mek Gunz (VEHICLE) — the shape of the real 11e pairings Big Mek / Mek -> Mek Gunz; the Warboss stands in a LIGHT terrain area (barricade), the gun outside it; Custodian Guard Alpha ~20" away; everything else removed; the fixture's terrain stashed (restored in cleanup); the defender allocates wounds (overlay).

steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
main.view_zoom = 0.6
var vps = main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
main.view_offset = Vector2(560, 1100) - vps / (2.0 * main.view_zoom)
main.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: 13.09 judged per model on its OWN keywords (19.03): the Warboss is hidden and beyond its 15" detection range from every Guard; the VEHICLE gun is not hidden, so the Attached unit is a legal target.

24.28 [PRECISION]: the hidden Warboss is NOT visible to any attacking model, so his group cannot be promoted. Before the fix the gate read the folded allocation unit — the Mek Gunz's VEHICLE keywords — and offered him (1 group).
the defender's allocation overlay for a [PRECISION] save batch
no PRECISION picker: nothing to promote
